profiles.name: Uldra
speciesTraits: Small Fey with −2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and +2 Wisdom. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. LA +1.
Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of the ordinary carrying and lifting limits. Uldras use Small weapons.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Racial spell-like abilities are ray of frost 3/day, speak with animals 1/day, and touch of fatigue 1/day. Caster level equals Hit Dice. Save DCs use Wisdom.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Common and Sylvan are automatic. All languages are available as bonus languages, and Speak Language is always a class skill. Favored class Druid.

npcBuilds.name: Rimewillow

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Uldra winter-trail guide, Druid 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +2, size +1. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +2, Will +5.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Nature Sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Skill Focus (Knowledge [nature]) adds +3. Wild empathy +1. The encounter begins without an animal companion present.
actions: Small quarterstaff +1 melee with one end for 1d4 bludgeoning, plus 1 cold with Frosty Touch active while holding it. Critical ×2.

Racial spell-like abilities, CL 1 from one Hit Die. Ray of frost 3/day, ranged touch +3 for 1d3 cold with no save. Speak with animals 1/day for 1 minute. Touch of fatigue 1/day, melee touch +1, Fortitude DC 13 negates, duration 1 round. The save is Wisdom-based.
Prepared druid spells, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First-level spells are cure light wounds for 1d8+1 healing and entangle (Reflex DC 14, vegetation required).
build.tactics: Rimewillow uses speak with animals to ask a fox which trail remains open. She takes the party through a cold hollow and uses the staff only if something blocks the way.

npcBuilds.motive: Find a trail that the stranded travelers can cross.
npcBuilds.hook: Rimewillow knows where a fox has been using the hollow.

npcBuilds.name: Stillrime

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Uldra pass shelter guard, Monk 1
traits: Lawful good. Unarmored, size +1, Dexterity +2, Wisdom +3. Touch 16, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +5. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Nature Scholar (Ex) grants +2 racial on Knowledge (nature) and makes it a class skill.
Cold Resistance (Ex). Cold environments do not harm the Uldra or its equipment. Against attacks that deal cold damage, the Uldra has cold resistance 5.

Frosty Touch (Su). A free action frosts the hands. While frosty, unarmed attacks deal +1 cold damage. A wielded melee weapon deals +1 cold on a hit while held. The extra cold does not stack with a magic weapon’s cold damage.
Fey Blood. Uldras are Fey. Effects limited to Humanoids do not affect them, and effects that target Fey apply. They have no special cold iron weakness.
Improved Unarmed Strike and Stunning Fist are Monk bonus feats. Stunning Fist is 1/day. Declare before the attack roll. On a damaging hit, Fortitude DC 13 prevents a one-round stun.
actions: Small Monk unarmed strike +1 melee for 1d4 bludgeoning, plus 1 cold with Frosty Touch. Unarmed flurry as a full attack uses two strikes at −1 each, same damage on each hit.

Racial spell-like abilities, CL 1 from one Hit Die. Ray of frost 3/day, ranged touch +3 for 1d3 cold with no save. Speak with animals 1/day for 1 minute. Touch of fatigue 1/day, melee touch +1, Fortitude DC 13 negates, duration 1 round. The save is Wisdom-based.
build.tactics: Stillrime guards the shelter entrance as the party brings travelers through the pass. He activates Frosty Touch before engaging and uses the ray if a target stays out of reach. Apply normal cold resistance to his separate cold damage.

npcBuilds.motive: Hold the shelter entrance until the travelers are inside.
npcBuilds.hook: Stillrime can hear movement beyond the snowbank outside the shelter.
